what: a hollow pipe (outer diameter 10, wall 2) along a path of two lines joined by a tangent R20 quarter arc
method: a tube of constant ring section along a path of length 30 + (pi/2) 20 + 30 = 91.416: V = pi (5^2 - 3^2) L (Pappus: the section centre follows the path; R 20 > 5). Faces: outer cylinder, torus, cylinder; inner cylinder, torus, cylinder; two annular ends = 8.
